what: The workspace no longer resolves: crates/blaze-doc/Cargo.toml:25 asks pulldown-cmark for features [html, simd], but the root Cargo.toml:244 pins pulldown-cmark 0.9.6, which has no `html` feature (it exists from 0.10). Either bump the workspace pin to a version with `html` or drop the feature. Blocks every cargo run.
